title: The Garies and Their Friends
author: Frank J. Webb
description: "The Garies and Their Friends" by Frank J.
longDescription: Webb is a novel written in the mid-19th century that explores themes of race, identity, and society in America during a period of intense debate over slavery and racial relations.

authorInfo.bio: Frank J. Webb (1828–1894) wrote The Garies and Their Friends. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
